description: Permissions for the main webview only: core defaults, the folder-picker dialog, and opening http(s) links in the default browser. Granted by webview label rather than window label on purpose. RuntimeAuthority::resolve_access matches a capability's webviews OR its windows, and a child webview of the main window carries window label "main", so a "windows" grant would hand these commands to every webview of that window - including one hosting a remote page. The main webview-window's webview label equals its window label, so this grants exactly what it granted before.
